description: This Java class, SamplingDataPrinter, is responsible for logging diagnostic sampling performance data. It processes SamplingData objects, formats their timing metrics (such as 99th percentile, average, median, lowest), and outputs these details via SLF4J logging.

classes.name: SamplingDataPrinter
classes.description: A component class designed to print and log performance sampling data, including timings statistics such as percentiles, averages, and medians.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Logs formatted sampling data for each class if available and enabled.

methods.name: getFormattedSamplingData
methods.description: Creates a formatted string representing the sampling data for a specific class.

methods.name: getTimingsLog
methods.description: Generates a log string for all timing entries.

methods.name: getSingleTimingLog
methods.description: Generates a detailed statistics string for a specific timing key, including percentiles, average, and minimum durations.
